flow: ui-path — flip the composer reasoning-mode toggle and read the button text back (VERIFIED live 2026-09-23)

steps.note: Anonymous chat — no session snapshot needed.
Composer button whose text is the current mode ('Fast' or 'Reasoning').
Opens a popover with [role='menuitemradio'] rows: 'Reasoning / Takes longer to respond' and 'Fast / Answers right away'.
args.mode='fast'|'reasoning' (default 'fast'). 'extended' is NOT offered by the free-tier GPT-5.6 Luna composer (measured 2026-09-23) — the runner reports that honestly as ok:false, never fabricated.
STATE read-back: the composer button text flips Fast<->Reasoning. Escape to close the popover.

rpc: The selected mode rides the NEXT POST /duckchat/v1/chat request as reasoningEffort (bundle-verified; values from DUCKCHAT_REASONING_MODE_{FAST,REASONING,EXTENDED_REASONING} i18n). Extended thinking additionally sets extendedThinking in request metadata for supporting plus/pro models.
stealth: drives only the site's own reasoning-mode toggle; identical to a user picking the mode in the UI. No synthetic request.
